nc6248b6b68.headline: Bank of Cyprus prices EUR300 million 5% green senior preferred notes
nc6248b6b68.summary: Bank of Cyprus Holdings will issue €300 million of green senior preferred notes at 5% under its euro medium-term note programme, with settlement expected next week.
nc6248b6b68.why: Bank of Cyprus is the island's largest listed lender, and its debt issuance shows how it raises funding for its balance sheet.

n466bcece28.headline: The Shyft Group Reports First Quarter 2024 Results
n466bcece28.summary: The Shyft Group, a North American specialty vehicle manufacturer listed on NASDAQ, reported its first-quarter 2024 results. Further financial details were not included in the candidate text.
n466bcece28.why: The Shyft Group makes specialty commercial vehicles such as walk-in vans and emergency response vehicles. Its quarterly results signal demand in the North American fleet and specialty vehicle market.

n58167a95f1.headline: HERTZ REPORTS FIRST QUARTER 2024 RESULTS
n58167a95f1.summary: Hertz reported first quarter 2024 results, with fleet and direct operating costs weighing on performance. CEO Gil West said the company is working to secure the right supply of vehicles.
n58167a95f1.why: Hertz is a major car rental company whose results reflect vehicle fleet costs and travel demand. Its quarterly figures are watched as a read on the car rental and travel sectors.

nd7fa768632.headline: Newmont sells gold stream to Lundin for $330m
nd7fa768632.summary: Newmont has finalised the sale of a stream credit facility and offtake agreement for the Fruta del Norte gold mine in Ecuador to Lundin Gold for $330 million. The deal is part of Newmont's efforts to monetise non-core assets after its 2023 Newcrest acquisition.
nd7fa768632.why: Newmont is one of the world's largest gold miners, and streaming and offtake deals are common ways miners raise capital without issuing equity.

n00e3e5d230.headline: Venice begins test phase of day-tripper fee to help balance tourism and resident needs
n00e3e5d230.summary: Venice has begun a pilot phase of a day-tripper fee aimed at balancing tourism with resident needs. Officials hope the test will provide more precise visitor figures.
n00e3e5d230.why: Tourism fees and visitor caps affect hotel, retail and travel demand in heavily visited cities, which matters for tourism-dependent businesses.

ne06e1fbe0d.headline: Geopark Announces First Quarter 2024 Operational Update
ne06e1fbe0d.summary: Geopark reported strong production in its Llanos 34 and CPO-5 blocks, driving current output to over 38,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. The update covers the first quarter of 2024.
ne06e1fbe0d.why: Geopark is an oil and gas producer with main operations in Colombia, so its output and reserves depend on those fields.

n502bbe9d53.headline: Alfa Laval AB (publ) Interim report January 1 - March 31, 2024
n502bbe9d53.summary: Alfa Laval reported order intake of SEK 18.3 billion, up 1 percent organically, and net sales of SEK 14.9 billion, up 7 percent organically for January to March 2024.
n502bbe9d53.why: Alfa Laval is a Swedish industrial heat transfer and separation equipment maker whose orders and sales signal demand across marine, energy and process industries.

ndf8f91a9c8.headline: Persistently High Commodity Prices Could Delay Interest Rate Cuts, World Bank Says
ndf8f91a9c8.summary: The World Bank expects commodity prices to soften this year and next but to remain well above pre-pandemic levels. That makes it harder for central banks to lower inflation and loosen policy.
ndf8f91a9c8.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender whose global economic forecasts influence investor views on inflation and the timing of interest-rate cuts.

n6478e01912.headline: Alfa Laval AB (publ) Interim report January 1 - March 31, 2024
n6478e01912.summary: Alfa Laval's interim report for January to March 2024 shows order intake of SEK 18.3 billion, up 1 percent organically. Net sales rose to SEK 14.9 billion.
n6478e01912.why: Alfa Laval is a Swedish industrial group supplying heat transfer, separation and fluid handling equipment to energy, marine and process industries.

n181dc1c01c.headline: Sonic Automotive Q1 Profit Declines

n181dc1c01c.why: Sonic Automotive is a US auto dealership group, and its results reflect consumer demand for vehicles and dealer margins.

n347c32a934.headline: Wizz Air Sees FY24 Net Income In Line With Guidance - Quick Facts
n347c32a934.summary: Wizz Air issued a post-close trading update saying it expects full-year fiscal 2024 net income of 350 million to 370 million euros, in line with guidance.
n347c32a934.why: Wizz Air is a low-cost European airline, and its profitability reflects fuel costs, fares and passenger demand across its routes.

n10987c4073.headline: Coal and new gas power plants will have to meet climate pollution targets
n10987c4073.summary: The Environmental Protection Agency finalized rules to limit climate-warming pollution from existing coal plants and new gas power plants, fifteen years after declaring greenhouse gases a danger to public health.
n10987c4073.why: EPA is the US federal agency that sets environmental regulations, and its power-plant rules affect utility costs, fuel choices and capital spending in the power sector.
